name: Note count
description: Shows how many notes are in the current branch.
source: (async () => { const notes = await window.driftleafExtension.listNotes(); const main = document.createElement("main"); main.style.cssText = "font:16px system-ui;padding:32px"; const heading = document.createElement("h1"); heading.textContent = "Branch overview"; const summary = document.createElement("p"); summary.textContent = `${notes.length} notes`; main.append(heading, summary); document.body.replaceChildren(main); })();

name: Database summary
description: Lists only the databases you explicitly grant access to.
source: (async () => { const databases = await window.driftleafExtension.listDatabases(); const main = document.createElement("main"); main.style.cssText = "font:16px system-ui;padding:32px"; const heading = document.createElement("h1"); heading.textContent = "Shared databases"; main.append(heading); const list = document.createElement("ul"); for (const database of databases) { const item = document.createElement("li"); item.textContent = database.title; list.append(item); } if (!databases.length) { const item = document.createElement("li"); item.textContent = "No database access granted"; list.append(item); } main.append(list); document.body.replaceChildren(main); })();
